description: This file defines a React context provider for managing a wishlist in a frontend application. It includes functions for adding, removing, toggling, and clearing wishlist items, persists data to local storage, and provides a hook for consuming the wishlist context.

methods.name: WishlistProvider
methods.description: A React functional component providing the wishlist context to its children.

methods.name: useWishlist
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the wishlist context.
